summary: CONTACT/COMMS exhaustive test (38 checks across 3 clean CDP runs on own ports 8421/8422, own profiles; localStorage cleared before default checks; 0 console errors in every block). Working: add via cfgComm*/addCommBtn; renderCommList rows; footer chips (icon+label+href, one / per entry — each chip contains an inner for the emoji, not a stray element); wa.me international conversion for contact numbers (01020306395 -> https://wa.me/201020306395); https guard (javascript:/ftp: social values fall back to a non-link , plain http(s) URLs stay links); text-type renders non-link chip; edit (editComm loads the right row into the form, addOrUpdateComm replaces in place, index cleared and button label restored, count unchanged); delete removes row and persists; language switch re-renders footer with correct AR/EN labels; settings persist across reload; mock-publish PUBLISHED_DATA block contains all comms and they survive reload; footer XSS is fully escaped ( and render as text and never execute). BUGS: (1) [HIGH, security] renderCommList (admin list) injects comm icon/name/value raw into innerHTML without escHtml — '' creates a real element that FAILS TO LOAD and FIRES onerror (verified: window.__x1 became true on a real injected element). Stored XSS via admin panel. Fixed by wrapping c.icon and the label/value with escHtml like the footer already does. (2) [HIGH, correctness] S.comms shares the same array object as DEFAULT_SETTINGS.comms (S = Object.assign({}, DEFAULT_SETTINGS) is shallow; loadSettings does the same), so addOrUpdateComm's S.comms.push POLLUTES DEFAULT_SETTINGS — after reset the 'defaults' are whatever was last added (verified: added 'Extra' in a fresh session, reset returned Instagram/Facebook/Extra, and DEFAULT_SETTINGS itself mutated; PUBLISHED_DEFAULTS.settings.comms shows 3 entries in index.html likely from the same shared-reference path or a manual edit). Fix: deep-slice comms on assignment (merged.comms = merged.comms. ? -> merged.comms = merged.comms.slice() / DEFAULT_SETTINGS.comms.map(c=>({...c})) everywhere S.comms is set). (3) [MEDIUM, UX] addOrUpdateComm has no dedupe — adding two identical methods creates two entries (verified dupeCount=2 in a clean session); DEBATABLE whether this is desired (maybe admin intends 2 similar links), but spec says identical adds must not duplicate. Recommendation: skip push if an identical {icon,ar,en,value,type} entry exists (toast duplicate). (4) [LOW, data] The shipped PUBLISHED_DATA:BEGIN block in index.html contains a third duplicate Instagram entry (Instagram/Facebook/Instagram), so every fresh browser loads 3 comms until reset. Not a runtime bug — fix the block (or the publish flow that wrote it).
working: add method via cfgCommIcon/cfgCommAr/cfgCommEn/cfgCommValue/cfgCommType + addCommBtn -> S.comms.push, saveSettings, renderCommList, renderFooterComms
renderCommList: rows with icon/name/value + edit/delete buttons; list length matches S.comms
footer chips: icon + bilingual label + correct <a href>/<span> per type
wa.me intl conversion: contact number 01020306395 -> https://wa.me/201020306395
https guard: javascript: and ftp: social values -> non-link <span>; http:// URLs accepted as links (code only allows http(s))
edit: editComm loads correct row into form (editCommIdx set), addOrUpdateComm replaces entry in place, index cleared, button label restored, count unchanged
delete: removes row + persists in localStorage + footer updates
language switch re-renders footer with correct AR/EN labels
mock publish: PUBLISHED_DATA block contains all comms and they survive reload; fresh-browser load uses published settings
footer XSS: and payloads render escaped in footer chips, nothing executes
defaults (Instagram/Facebook) return after reset (when S doesn't share DEFAULT_SETTINGS array — i.e. after reload path or pristine session)

bugs.desc: renderCommList injects comms raw into innerHTML (lines ~1804-1806): c.icon drawn unescaped -> an payload creates a REAL img element whose onerror handler executed in-session (verified window.__x1===true after failed load). payloads render as literal elements (count 11 observed). Footer is correctly escaped; admin list is not.
bugs.fix: Wrap all comm fields with escHtml() in the row template (icon, label, value), matching renderFooterComms.

bugs.desc: S.comms === DEFAULT_SETTINGS.comms (same array reference) because S = Object.assign({}, DEFAULT_SETTINGS) and loadSettings()'s merged = Object.assign({}, DEFAULT_SETTINGS, pub, d) both shallow-copy. S.comms.push therefore mutates DEFAULT_SETTINGS. Verified in a fresh session: adding 'Extra' made DEFAULT_SETTINGS.comms contain Instagram/Facebook/Extra, and reset then 'restored' Instagram/Facebook/Extra instead of the true defaults. Also explains the shipped PUBLISHED_DEFAULTS block having a 3rd duplicate Instagram entry.
bugs.fix: Deep-copy comms wherever S is built: S = Object.assign({}, DEFAULT_SETTINGS, {comms: DEFAULT_SETTINGS.comms.map(c=>({...c}))}) and same in loadSettings; or make renderFooterComms/addOrUpdateComm always operate on a fresh array.

bugs.desc: addOrUpdateComm always pushes; adding two identical methods creates two entries (verified dupeCount=2, S.comms length grew twice). Spec expects identical adds not to duplicate.
bugs.fix: In addOrUpdateComm, before push, if S.comms.some(c=>c.icon===icon&&c.ar===ar&&c.en===en&&c.value===value&&c.type===type) -> toast 'already exists' and skip.

bugs.desc: 'PUBLISHED_DEFAULTS.settings.comms' inside index.html has 3 entries (Instagram, Facebook, duplicate Instagram), so every fresh/non-storage browser renders 3 footer chips until an admin resets. Likely a side effect of B2 or an accidental manual entry.
bugs.fix: Edit the PUBLISHED_DATA block to remove the third entry and keep it to exactly Instagram+Facebook.

verdict: BLOCKER: 2 real bugs — admin-list stored XSS (B1) + shallow-copy DEFAULT_SETTINGS pollution (B2, also corrupts reset/defaults). Recommend fixing B1+B2 (and ideally B3/B4) before publish.
